page_content: A massive sinkhole has opened up on the main road near metro pillar 142 due to a sewer line burst; it is extremely dangerous for commuters.
The main sewage trunk line behind the civil hospital has exploded, and toxic waste is flooding the emergency ward entrance.
Sewage water is backflowing into the drinking water pipes at the local market; the water is black and smells of chemicals.
A heavy water main has burst near the main chowk, and the force of the water is literally stripping the asphalt off the road.
The manhole cover near the primary school gate is missing, and the pit is overflowing with fast-moving sludge; it's a death trap for kids.
Foundations of the old buildings near the nallah are vibrating because of a massive underground pipe leak; we fear a collapse.
Electric poles are sparking because the street is flooded with 3 feet of sewage water near the bus stand.
The public water tank at the colony entrance is leaking so badly that the surrounding soil has completely washed away, making the structure tilt.
Industrial effluent is being illegally discharged into our residential sewer line, causing explosive gas buildup in the manholes.
A large section of the road behind the mall has caved in due to hidden pipe erosion; a biker almost fell in today.
Drinking water in our basti is contaminated with sewage and smells like rotten eggs; several children have been hospitalized with typhoid.
The sewage pumping station near the river has failed and raw waste is flooding the nearby low-lying houses.
A water tanker overturned near the highway junction because the road softened due to an underground pipe burst.
Raw sewage is gushing out of the floor drains in the basement parking of the shopping complex; it's a massive health hazard.
The water main near the petrol pump has snapped, and the high-pressure jet is hitting the overhead power lines.
Entire street near the police chowki is flooded with dark sludge, and the smell is so strong that people are fainting.
A huge crack has appeared in the main supply pipe near the railway crossing, and water is flooding the tracks, stopping trains.
The sewer line has collapsed under the main market street, and the ground is sinking under the weight of passing trucks.
Methane gas is whistling out of the manholes near the garbage dump; one spark could cause a massive explosion.
The water treatment plant's main valve has failed, and unchlorinated, muddy water is being sent to the whole city.
A massive sewage leak is eroding the base of the flyover pillar near the station; the structure looks compromised.
Water from a broken pipe is spraying directly into an open electricity junction box near the rickshaw stand.
The nallah is overflowing with foam and black water, entering the houses of the laborers behind the factory zone.
The main drinking water reservoir has been breached, and dirty storm water is mixing with the supply.
Pressure in the sewer line is so high that manhole covers are literally popping off and flying into the air.
The drainage line near the temple has choked, and the holy pond is now filled with human excreta.
A water line burst inside the tunnel of the new metro line, causing immediate flooding of the tracks.
An underground fire in the sewer line near the textile market is sending thick, toxic smoke through the house toilets.
The embankment of the sewage canal near the bypass road has collapsed, and sludge is blocking the highway.
Drinking water supply is coming out with bright blue chemical dye near the industrial estate; don't let anyone drink it!
There has been no water supply in our locality for 72 hours; residents are now buying expensive private tankers.
The gutter near the main chowk is choked and stinking water is overflowing onto the shop fronts since Monday.
Water pressure is so low in Block D that the water doesn't even reach the first floor without a heavy pump.
The drainage pipe behind the local market is leaking slowly, making the whole area smell like a toilet.
Public toilets near the bus stand are unusable because the flush system isn't working and the drains are blocked.
The water we are getting in the taps is very muddy and yellow; we can't use it for cooking or bathing.
A manhole cover is broken and sitting unevenly near the bakery; it's causing a lot of noise and small trip hazards.
The supply timing has become very irregular; sometimes it comes at 2 AM and sometimes not at all.
There is a persistent leak in the pipeline near the park gate that has turned the sidewalk into a muddy mess.
Rainwater is not draining away from the lane behind the hospital because the storm drains are filled with plastic.
The sewer line in our lane gets choked every second week; we need a permanent replacement of the narrow pipes.
Water bill for our small house has come to 50,000 rupees; there must be a major underground leak after the meter.
The community tap near the post office has been broken for days, and thousands of liters of water are just going into the drain.
We can hear water rushing underground near the apartment gate, but nothing is coming out of the taps.
The garbage from the open drain hasn't been cleared, and now the water is starting to seep into our ground floor rooms.
Ever since the road was relaid, the manholes are 4 inches below the road level, causing cars to hit their undercarriages.
The smell of sewage is coming through our kitchen sinks every evening; there must be a vent pipe blockage.
The valve man hasn't turned on the water for our lane today, while the neighboring lane is getting full supply.
A small puddle of sewage has formed near the vegetable vendor's spot, attracting too many flies and mosquitoes.
The water tank in our locality hasn't been cleaned in years; we found a dead pigeon in the filter today.
A construction company has diverted the sewage line into a temporary pit that is now overflowing into our street.
The overhead tank is overflowing for 4 hours every morning because the auto-cut sensor is broken.
Roots of a large peepal tree have entered the sewer line near the temple, causing a slow but constant backup.
The water supply pipe is vibrating and making a loud hammer-like sound every time the pump starts.
The public water booth near the station is leaking from the base and making the whole area slippery.
Drains in our colony haven't been desilted before the monsoon, and the first rain has already caused waterlogging.
The plumber from the department came but left the pipe half-fixed; water is still spraying out like a fountain.
A heavy oily substance is floating in the open drain behind the car workshop, and it's starting to smell very bad.
The concrete cover of the storm drain near the rickshaw stand has cracked and is about to fall in.
We are getting water for only 15 minutes a day, which isn't even enough to fill one bucket per person.
The public drinking water tap at the park is dripping continuously and needs a washer change.
The marking for the underground water valve near the metro pillar has faded and needs repainting.
There are some dry leaves and a little bit of plastic stuck in the grating of the storm drain near the clinic.
The plaster on the municipal water tank wall near the colony gate is peeling off and looks a bit untidy.
A small weed is growing out of the gap in the manhole cover near the library.
The handle of the community hand pump near the bazaar is a bit loose and makes a squeaky noise.
The 'Save Water' signage near the primary school is bent and needs to be straightened.
There is a very minor dampness on the pavement near the water meter box which might indicate a tiny sweat leak.
The cement surrounding the manhole near my house is chipped and needs a small touch-up.
The lid of the water meter box in our lane doesn't close perfectly; it stays slightly ajar.
The blue paint indicating the 'Water Dept' on the side of the bridge has been covered by posters.
A small amount of sand has accumulated near the drain mouth at the end of the street after the last windstorm.
The tap at the public urinal is slightly tight and hard for older people to turn off completely.
Requesting a small fence around the water valve near the playground to keep kids from playing with it.
The concrete slab over the drain behind the temple is a bit wobbly and needs some leveling.
There is a faint smell of chlorine in the water today; perhaps the dosage was slightly high but harmless.
The iron rungs inside the manhole near the milk booth are getting rusted and will eventually need replacement.
One of the decorative tiles on the heritage water fountain at the main chowk has fallen off.
The pipe carrying water to the park garden has a very small pinhole leak that sprays a tiny mist.
The lock on the pump house door near the community center is getting jammed and needs some oiling.
Some moss has started growing on the steps of the public water tank; it's a bit slippery.
The plastic pipe cover near the meter room has a small crack but isn't leaking yet.
The drainage channel in the parking lot has some silt that needs a routine sweep-up.
The water pressure at the very end of the lane is slightly less than at the beginning, though still okay.
Requesting a new 'Don't Waste Water' board near the colony's main overhead tank.
The metal plate covering the old defunct borewell is a bit rusty and needs a fresh coat of anti-rust paint.
The pebbles near the drainage outlet at the park have scattered and need to be put back in place.
A small bird's nest is blocking the overflow pipe of the small tank near the guard room.
The white wash on the base of the pipeline pillars near the canal is getting dirty.
The valve wheel near the intersection is a bit stiff to operate during maintenance.
